doc.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25

title: Laurena Diggs's education and affiliations
summary: She lists schools in Mississippi, Chicago and Wisconsin; the end of the block is garbled repetition.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Don't you have that left phone? You want to cook over? Yeah, I think I'm playing food. Oh, you didn't tell us about your education any time. I think you left off.

Well, I attended public school in Morris Point, Mississippi, and then I attended Miller's Ferranormal Industrial School. And then, in the later years, I finished a course at the Roosevelt College in Chicago of Public Speaking. And in 1946, I finished a course at the University of Wisconsin. And then, from the University of Wisconsin, I went to the University of Chicago. And in the later years, I was a member. Wait, I've got the papers to show you. A member of the executive board.
